$comment: Wave 3 page photos (owner approval 2026-11-09, docs/plans/2026-11-09-wave-3-photos.md). Uploaded to maarifcms only (upload-to-cms.mjs), never built into the site. 'photos' adds to media-selection.json; 'pages' names each inner page's header and its row of photos (band-1..3) by photo id from either file. Consent: non-identifiable = no pupil can be recognised (or no people); adults = only adults can be recognised.
